column1: # The function at 0x005436e0 in tesobjectcell.cpp, which duplicates a cell and
# wraps each duplicated NavMesh with MakeNavMeshPointer (0x00464fc0) (VEGAS-96).
# The callee returns an 8-byte NiPointer<NavMesh> with a destructor, so on
# windows-x64 it takes the address of the result as its first argument. The
# caller then destroys that result. A caller that sees the class as trivial
# expects the result in a register, passes the mesh where the callee expects
# the result address, and never calls the destructor: the required destructor
# is the relocation that tells the two forms apart.
# The name under which the unit's recipe symbols name the callee, with a
# NavMeshPtr result. No object defines it; the call goes to the name the
# batch, unit, function, the callee and the destructor of its result:
